spaces.name: Front courtyard & facade
spaces.current: A bright tiled front courtyard with palm trees, cacti and pebble planters wraps the peach-toned villa's staircase and upper balcony.
spaces.potential: Restyled with lounge seating and potted greenery it becomes a sun-drenched Mediterranean arrival and outdoor living zone.
spaces.reason: Best full view of the villa and its private courtyard; #2 is the stronger, more complete composition.

spaces.name: Living room
spaces.current: A spacious open-plan lounge with dated fabric sofas, a stone fireplace, patterned rug and tiled floors flows toward the kitchen.
spaces.potential: Restyled with contemporary sofas and neutral textiles it reads as a large, light-filled family living space.
spaces.reason: Three angles of one large living space; #7 shows scale and flow best.

spaces.name: Dining area
spaces.current: A dark-wood dresser wall and curtained window frame a small round dining table in the corner of the living area.
spaces.potential: Lighter furniture and simpler window dressing would open up this cosy dining nook.
spaces.reason: Distinct dining space worth showing as a supporting shot.

spaces.name: Kitchen
spaces.current: A large oak-fronted kitchen with granite counters, tiled splashback and appliances lining an open galley layout.
spaces.potential: Refaced cabinetry and updated fittings would modernise this generously sized kitchen.
spaces.reason: Two angles of one kitchen; #5 shows the fuller open layout.

spaces.name: Master bedroom
spaces.current: A bright master bedroom with pine bed, fitted mirrored wardrobes and matching nightstands.
spaces.potential: Restyled bedding and softer lighting turn this into a calm, hotel-like master suite.
spaces.reason: Best double bedroom with wardrobes; #11 is the warmer, more inviting angle.

spaces.name: Double bedroom
spaces.current: A double bedroom with pine furniture, dresser and a large curtained window with air conditioning.
spaces.potential: Fresh linens and lighter styling brighten this comfortable second double.
spaces.reason: Second distinct double; #13 is brighter with more storage shown. #12 is redundant.

spaces.name: Twin bedroom
spaces.current: A twin bedroom with two single beds, monochrome bedspreads and a curtained window.
spaces.potential: Coordinated bedding and a rug make an easy guest or children's room.
spaces.reason: Adds bed count and shows the villa's guest capacity.

spaces.name: Family bathroom
spaces.current: A blue-tiled family bathroom with bathtub, bidet, toilet and vanity beneath a bright window.
spaces.potential: Neutral retiling and a modern vanity would refresh this dated blue scheme.
spaces.reason: Best full bathroom; #14 shows the complete room with tub.

spaces.name: Shower room
spaces.current: A compact mosaic-tiled shower room with pedestal basin, corner shower enclosure and toilet.
spaces.potential: Updated tiling and glass would modernise this secondary shower room.
spaces.reason: Skipped — dated, cluttered and redundant to the stronger family bathroom.
